text:
Aisha (partnerships): Heads-up: LangChain wants a joint marketplace + sandbox GA with SigmaSI. We should run a two-phase playbook: private pilot week of May 5 -> public marketplace listing May 19. Looking for alignment on tech cert, demo script, and co-marketing cadence.
Devon (eng): Quick q — can we commit to integration matrix + connector cert by Apr 28? DevEx needs a sample app and smoke tests.
Li Wei (solutions): We can reuse the gateway adapter from last sandbox but need to validate data-model mappings and auth flows. I'll drop a checklist in the drive.
Ravi (product): Product ask: can we add a telemetry flag so demo shows routing/perf? Need token-level traces for the live demo.
Devon (eng): Yep, we can add an opt-in param (routing=interop) and a brief telemetry payload. Will add to sandbox API.
Li Wei (solutions): Smoke test snippet (run in staging):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"input":"smoke test","routing":"interop"}' \n  https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/gateway/connector/run
```
Marco (legal): Pinged. Need partner logo, official partner name, and approved co-marketing boilerplate by Tue May 8. Send assets/legal copy to legal-assets@redwood.com.
ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline infra-sandbox #512 succeeded — https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra-sandbox/builds/512 :white_check_mark:
Aisha (partnerships): Who owns the customer-facing runbook + demo script for the pilot? Solutions or Product?
Li Wei (solutions): I'll draft the runbook + demo script. Will include an FAQ covering pricing, SLA, and data handling.
Ravi (product): Sales needs a one-pager with marketplace SKU, pricing tiers, and expected throughput per tier. Can we have a draft by May 9?
Devon (eng): I can provision a dedicated sandbox env for the pilot: cluster cs-psi-03. ETA Tue morning. Will also enable the routing flag and example telemetry endpoint.
Aisha (partnerships): Action items: Li -> runbook & demo, Devon -> env + routing flag, Marco -> legal assets & approved copy, Ravi -> pricing one-pager. I'll run the partner pre-brief Wed 11am PT.
Li Wei (solutions): :thumbsup: added the checklist and initial runbook to the doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (comments enabled)
Aisha (partnerships): :calendar: Pre-brief invite sent to LangChain + SigmaSI. Please review runbook before Wed.
Marco (legal): Noted, will review marketing copy by Mon evening and flag any IP concerns.
Devon (eng): FYI I'll add a small perf section to the runbook with expected latencies for 4k tokens on dedicated vs shared.
Ravi (product): Great. If we hit the pilot metrics, we'll ask Marketplace to fast-track listing.
Aisha (partnerships): Thanks all — will post a short status update after the pre-brief.
